name: Dillingers Barber Shop

reviews.text:
I’ve been going to Alex every few weeks for the last four years now - so it’s probably time I write a review and tell everyone how amazing she is!
I really can’t say enough good things about this barber. Alex isn’t just good, she is CONSISTENTLY good - and that’s almost more important to me as a fellow service industry professional. She is attentive and intuitive, and a friendly and engaging conversationalist as well.
I’ve given Alex’s card to many, many folks after they’ve complimented my hair. I always enjoy my time in her chair and I always leave feeling good about myself because my hair looks fantastic.
Everyone else in the shop is also super friendly and the vibes are always good. Truly always a pleasant experience at Dillinger’s, and I’m so grateful for Alex!
reviews.author: Rowan Taki

reviews.text: I love this spot. I’ve been getting my hair cut with Alex for the past three years—she’s terrific. About a year ago I started taking my toddler. She was calm and gentle with him and he now really likes going there. Great cut and service, will keep going
reviews.author: Andrew deCoriolis

reviews.text: Dillingers is a solid barbershop. Ive been coming here for 7+ years and have never had a bad cut - however thats mostly because 95% of them have been from Alex who I highly reccomend!
reviews.author: Timothy Navarrette

reviews.text: DJ is great with my kids. He does a great job cutting the kids’ hair and an even better job making them feel comfortable and confident. 5 stars for grownup haircut and conversation as well.
reviews.author: David J Raphael

reviews.text: This place is great! From the polite staff, to the lobby area, and the amazing level of skill their barber’s possess, I recommend Dillingers if you want a great haircut & experience!
reviews.author: Doug Moe
